owner_statement: Gold Standards are not intended to force every creative into the same left-copy/right-merchandise arrangement. The reference system should learn a RANGE of successful structures. Centered messaging can be valid. Asymmetric messaging can be valid. Environmental photography can be valid. Merchandise-led composition can be valid. Do not average all Gold Standards into one generic template.
constants: recognizable brand presence (navy band or equivalent close)
variables: composition structure: LEFT_COPY | CENTERED | RIGHT_COPY | TOP_COPY_BOTTOM_SCENE | ENVIRONMENTAL_FULL_BLEED | HERO_OBJECT
merchandise grouping: room vignette | tabletop vignette | outdoor staging | single hero | person + props (generic acquisition only)
headline location and case (title-case serif | uppercase condensed)
red emphasis device (word | line | rule | swash | CTA)

rules.no_averaging: the principle extractor emits per-attribute RANGES and the set of structures seen, never a mean layout; a brief must name the structure chosen and why
rules.rotation: for a class with ≥ 2 Gold/approved structures, consecutive creatives for the same objective must not reuse the same structure; the retriever returns the structure list with each reference's structure tagged
rules.distance: 3P G11 unchanged: signature distance ≥ τ_ref from every reference (Gold included) and ≥ τ_self from recent creatives; a Gold is never closer than τ_ref
rules.prop_checklist_ban: the recurring collaborator props (bronze horse, blue-and-white vase, category-spine books, laptop with logo, script mug/board/box) are tagged in do_not_generalize; the object selector must not treat them as required; a scene containing ≥ 3 of them together is flagged 'template echo' and regenerated

buyer_platform_growth: LEFT_COPY tabletop vignette with laptop prop (REF-19)

structures_owner_named_valid_but_unseen: environmental photography full-bleed (seen in 3P references REF-09/10 and West University C)
merchandise-led with minimal copy (3P REF-02 style) for Advantage.Bid-led classes
rules.proving_ground: each class generates candidates across ≥ 2 structures so the Owner's next feedback extends the range rather than narrowing it
